rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun choice for happiness as joy or emotional enjoyment.

example.english: I think having happiness is enough.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 jau5 faai3 lok6 zau6 gau3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for happiness understood as lasting well-being or a fortunate life situation rather than a moment of joy.

example.english: Having my family around and a stable job gives me a lasting sense of happiness.
example.traditional: 有屋企人陪住，又有份穩定嘅工，我覺得自己好幸福。
example.jyutping: jau5 uk1 kei2 jan4 pui4 zyu6 jau6 jau5 fan6 wan2 ding6 ge3 gung1 ngo5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hou2 hang6 fuk1
